active_context_version.derivation: pass-through string; expected constant C0-empty-store (zero variance)
active_context_version.missingness: none expected; zero variance documented, not manufactured

drawdown.derivation: (eq-peak)/peak over episode peak to current index
drawdown.pit_rule: decision-time snapshot + strictly prior same-episode snapshots

gold_return_5d.missingness: honest high missingness expected (contract calendar gaps)
gold_return_5d.pit_rule: GOLDAUG2023 contract closes strictly < T; no cross-contract mixing

instrument_return_1d.pit_rule: closes strictly < T; return over last 2 eligible closes

instrument_volatility_10d.derivation: sample stdev of last 10 eligible 1d returns

latest_cpi.derivation: cpi_index of latest eligible vintage + staleness days in manifest

latest_iip.derivation: iip_index of latest eligible vintage + staleness days in manifest

nifty_volatility_10d.derivation: sample stdev of last 10 eligible 1d returns

rbi_stance.derivation: stance string of latest eligible event
rbi_stance.pit_rule: announcement_date <= T; empty stance kept as missing

usdinr_return_5d.pit_rule: reference rates strictly < T (sparse grid: weekends absent)

vix_change_5d.agent_observes: no (V1 used vix level t-1; this is the change)
